Topology.title: Hybrid Cloud for Finance
Topology.Description: Set up a hybrid cloud environment with Azure Red Hat OpenShift and secure connection to on-premises datacenter.
Topology.Summary: The topology includes an Azure VNet with a Red Hat OpenShift cluster, a central firewall, and a private connection to the on-premises datacenter.

Control.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Inventory System' (n17) that manages inventory for various nodes and zones, indicating a detailed and maintained asset inventory.

Control.title: Document Data Flows
Control.Evidence: The topology includes multiple data flow links (e.g., nl3, nl4, nl5, etc.) and zone links (e.g., zl3, zl4) that document data flows between different components and zones.

Control.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
Control.Evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for sensitive and non-sensitive data (z4 and z5) with specific application servers (n_struct1 and n_struct2) and data flow links (zl3 and zl4) that segment data processing and storage based on sensitivity.

Control.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Central Firewall' (n2) and an 'On-Premises Firewall' (n3) that manage firewalls on servers and other assets.

Control.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n8) and links (nl4) that configure DNS resolution for the Azure Red Hat OpenShift Cluster (n1).

Control.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA Gateway' (n18) and links (nl30) that enforce MFA for remote access to the Azure Bastion (n5).

Control.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filter' (n9) and links (nl5) that provide DNS filtering services for the Azure Red Hat OpenShift Cluster (n1).

Control.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n10) and links (nl6) that enforce web proxy and URL filtering for the Azure Red Hat OpenShift Cluster (n1).

Control.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
Control.Evidence: The topology includes multiple zones (e.g., z1, z2, z3, z4, z5, z6, z7) and links (e.g., zl1, zl2, zl3, zl4, zl5, zl6, zl7, zl8, zl9, zl10, zl11) that demonstrate a segmented and secure network architecture.

Control.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'IaC Repository' (n19) and links (nl31) that manage infrastructure as code, and secure network protocols are implied by the use of management and monitoring links.

Control.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'AAA Server' (n11) and links (nl7) that centralize AAA for the Azure Bastion (n5).

Control.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Private connection' (zl1) between the Azure VNet (z1) and the On-Premises Datacenter (z2) via a VPN, and an 'AAA Server' (n11) that manages AAA for the Azure Bastion (n5).

Control.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'NIDS' (n12) and links (nl8) that monitor the Central Firewall (n2) for network intrusions.

Control.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Central Firewall' (n2) and links (nl_struct1, nl_struct2) that perform traffic filtering between the Sensitive Data Zone (z4) and Non-Sensitive Data Zone (z5).

Control.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Access Control Manager' (n20) and links (nl32) that enforce access control for remote access to the Azure Bastion (n5).

Control.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'SIEM' (n13) and links (nl9) that collect flow logs from the Central Firewall (n2).

Control.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
Control.Evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for sensitive and non-sensitive data (z4 and z5) and links (zl3 and zl4) that separate production and non-production systems.

Control.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Penetration Testing Workstation' (n16) and links (nl33) that manage penetration testing activities.
